name: Agent Board
description: Your coding agents across every machine Orca reaches, in one sidebar list: what needs you first, parents and their children, one project per Git remote.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Agent Board: agents that need you

settings.title: Default view
settings.description: The view a new Agent Board panel opens with.

settings.title: Refresh every (seconds)
settings.description: How often an open panel re-reads Orca, on top of live agent and workspace events. Nothing polls while no panel is open, except the status bar count, once a minute.

settings.title: Include floating workspace chats
settings.description: Lists this computer's floating workspace chats. Orca does not list them yet, so the board reads their ids from Orca's local session store (read-only, needs the sqlite3 command).
